## What's new

- Reworked toasts and the backend status indicator: when the backend can't be reached, the reason is shown.
- Minecraft 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 (Fabric). Figura 0.1.6 for these versions is built from the [official repository](https://github.com/FiguraMC/Figura).
- Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3 (Fabric). Requires [NoFigura](https://modrinth.com/mod/qMYudiOM) 0.1.6.x.
